items.example: I clean the floor every Saturday.

items.definition: to make clothes flat and smooth with an iron
items.example: I do the ironing on Sunday evening.

items.definition: to buy food and things for the home
items.example: We do the shopping on Friday.

items.definition: to clean the floor with a vacuum cleaner (or: do the hoovering)
items.example: He does the vacuuming once a week.
I do the washing on Monday.

items.definition: to wash the plates, cups and pans after a meal
items.example: Who does the washing-up in your house?

items.definition: to clean the dust from tables and shelves
items.example: She dusts the furniture every week.

items.definition: to put plates, knives and forks on the table before a meal
items.example: Can you lay the table, please?

items.definition: to take the plates and glasses off the table after a meal
items.example: I clear the table after dinner.

items.definition: to put dirty plates and glasses into the dishwasher
items.example: I load the dishwasher after dinner.
I make lunch for the children at one o'clock.

items.definition: to put the sheets and the duvet in order on the bed
items.example: I make the bed every morning.

items.definition: to lift dirty clothes from the floor
items.example: Please pick up your dirty clothes from the floor.

items.definition: to put clothes in the cupboard or drawers where they belong
items.example: Put away your clothes before you go to bed.

items.definition: to carry the rubbish out of the house to the bin
items.example: Can you take out the rubbish, please?

items.definition: to put things in the right place so the room looks neat
items.example: Tidy your room before your friends come.
